LandingPage.hero_title: Care for those who always cared for you,
LandingPage.hero_subtitle: even when you can't be close by.
LandingPage.hero_description: The complete solution to organize medications, meals, and the family routine. No confusion between siblings, no forgotten tasks.
LandingPage.problem_desc_1: Messy medicine boxes and doubts about what time to take them.
LandingPage.problem_desc_2: Misunderstandings between siblings about who did what.
LandingPage.problem_desc_3: Lack of expense tracking and unfair cost sharing.
LandingPage.solution_family_desc: Full control of medications, schedule, health reports, and expense sharing. Access for all siblings.
LandingPage.solution_elderly_desc: Ultra-simplified screen, focused only on what needs to be done right now. No distractions, made for those who struggle with technology.
LandingPage.features_title: Everything you need in one place
LandingPage.feature_meds_desc: Mobile alerts so you never miss a dose. Complete history.
LandingPage.feature_finance_desc: Log pharmacy and caregiver costs. The system calculates how much each sibling owes.
LandingPage.feature_routine_desc: Daily menu, hydration tracking, and medical/physiotherapy appointments.
LandingPage.pricing_title: Choose the ideal plan for your family
